3c35c81739.substituent_description: A central benzene ring carries, relative to the NH-bearing carbon (C1): the NH at C1, an OEt at C2 (ortho to the NH) and a 4-methyl-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl group at C4 (para to the NH). The NH is bonded to the ring N (the lower N) of a bicyclic 6-6 diaza-naphthalene-type system (one ring contains a CH2 next to that N); the upper ring of the bicycle has a ring N, a CH3 line (unlabelled) on the carbon next to it, and on the other side a 3-methoxy-2,2-dimethylazetidin-1-yl group (N-attached, CMe2 next to the N, CH(OMe) next to CMe2) attached to the carbon adjacent to the ring fusion.
3c35c81739.notes: Typeset drawing. Triazole: three N labels (two ring N plus the N bearing Me). Four unlabelled methyl line ends (two on azetidine C, one ring methyl on the bicycle, plus Me label on triazole N). Bicycle has four drawn double bonds (C=C, C=N, C=C, CH=CH); triazole two; benzene three.

333791d901.substituent_description: Left benzene ring (circle) is attached through its C1 to an NH, with F atoms on C3 and C4 (the two adjacent ring carbons next to each other on the side away from C2; i.e. meta and para to the NH). The NH is bonded to a C(=O) which is bonded to a CH carrying a hashed bond to an unlabelled terminus (methyl) and an O that forms an ester with a C(=O)-CH2-CH2- chain leading to the N of a six-membered benzo-fused ring (N, C(=O), CH2, O, and two ortho-fused aromatic carbons), i.e. a benzoxazinone whose N bears the chain.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: NH written as H stacked above N
hashed bond ends at an unlabelled atom (looks like a methyl line)
333791d901.notes: Handwritten. Three C=O double bonds (amide, ester, lactam), each drawn as two parallel lines. Both benzene rings drawn with a circle; the right ring is lighter ink.

906ac61923.substituent_description: An Et group on the end of a long unbranched zigzag chain (about ten unlabelled vertices) ends in an amide NH, C(=O), attached to a para-disubstituted benzene ring (circle). The para position of that ring carries a two-carbon (CH2CH2) linker to C4 of a piperidine whose N is acylated by C(=O)-CH2- attached to a second para-disubstituted benzene ring (circle), whose para position bears an N(Me)2 group.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: exact number of zigzag vertices in the long chain is hard to count
NH written as H stacked above N
906ac61923.notes: Handwritten, photographed on grey paper. Two C=O double bonds (benzamide C=O and the N-acyl C=O).

7e2111266d.substituent_description: A carbazole (two benzene rings with circles fused to a central five-membered ring bearing N) has CH2CH3 on the carbazole N and, on the outer benzene ring at the position corresponding to C2 of the carbazole (meta to the carbon bonded to N), a CH2 linked to the N of a piperidine. The piperidine C4 is a spiro carbon shared with a five-membered carbocycle fused to a benzene ring (circle); the carbon next to the spiro carbon bears OH on a solid wedge, and the other five-ring carbon (attached to the benzene) bears NH-C(=O)-CH3 via a hashed bond.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: a small thickened wedge-like stroke appears at the benzene-to-CH bond near the hashed bond carbon (not counted as a wedge)
carbonyl carbon written explicitly as C
7e2111266d.notes: Handwritten. One solid wedge to OH, one hashed bond to NH. Acetamide drawn as NH-C(CH3)=O with the C written explicitly.

c39d5add3f.substituent_description: A para-disubstituted benzene ring (circle) has EtOOC at one position and, para to it, a CH=C(CH3) vinyl group (one C=C, methyl drawn as an unlabelled line on the second alkene carbon). The alkene carbon bearing the methyl is attached to an aromatic ring (circle) that is fused to a saturated six-membered ring carrying two gem-dimethyl carbons (four unlabelled methyl lines, one pair on each carbon adjacent to the ring fusion on opposite sides), i.e. a tetramethyl-tetrahydronaphthalene attached at a beta position (meta to one fusion carbon, para to the other).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: first O of EtOOC looks like a D
ring bonds are irregular so ring junction details are hard to confirm
c39d5add3f.notes: Handwritten. Only one double bond (the alkene); the benzene rings are drawn with circles. Methyl groups are unlabelled line ends.

14b36be44c.substituent_description: A citrulline-like unit (H2N-C(=O)-NH-CH2CH2CH2-CH, with a solid wedge on the chain bond at the alpha carbon) is acylated on its N by a valine-like unit (iPr on a solid wedge, alpha carbon bearing NHBoc), and its C(=O) is bonded to an anilide NH on a benzene ring (circle). On that ring, relative to the NH at C1: a CH2OH at C4 (para) and a CH2-N(Me)-C(=O)-O-CH2-fluorenyl (fluorenylmethyl carbamate) at C3 (meta to NH, ortho to the CH2OH).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: NH in the amide chain written as N with H stacked below
ring position of CH2OH versus CH2N(Me)Fmoc carbon relative to the NH read from hand-drawn ring, moderately confident
14b36be44c.notes: Handwritten. Four C=O double bonds (urea, valine C=O, second amide C=O, carbamate C=O). Two solid wedges. Fluorene drawn as 6-5-6 with circles in both benzene rings; the iPr r looks like a gamma.

7dbdc3e204.substituent_description: A benzene ring (circle) bears an NH at one carbon and a Me on the adjacent carbon (ortho to the NH). The NH is attached to C2 of a quinoline-type bicycle (ring N next to the NH-bearing carbon; the N-containing ring is drawn with a circle and the fused benzo ring with two inner double lines), and C4 of that bicycle bears a C(=O)NHBn group.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: ring N label is slightly detached from its ring
benzo ring shows only two inner double lines
7dbdc3e204.notes: Handwritten. Double bonds: two inner lines in the fused benzo ring plus the C=O of the amide. Pyridine ring and left benzene ring are drawn with circles.

478fcf2668.substituent_description: A piperidine has EtO on C4 via a solid wedge and, on C2 (adjacent to N), a benzene ring attached through a hashed bond. That benzene ring (circle) has, relative to the piperidine-bearing carbon C1: an O-CH2CH2CH2-NHAc chain at C2 (ortho) and HO2C at C4 (para to C1, meta to the O). The piperidine N is attached through a CH2 to C4 of an indole (benzene ring with circle; pyrrole ring with one drawn C=C and an NH), where the indole ring carries MeO on C5 (next to the CH2-bearing carbon) and an unlabelled methyl line on C7 (next to the NH-bearing ring fusion carbon).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: number of CH2 groups in the O-chain read as three from hand-drawn zigzag
methyl on indole is an unlabelled line end
478fcf2668.notes: Handwritten. Aromatic rings: both benzene rings have circles; the five-membered ring has one drawn double bond.

58738dee0a.substituent_description: A 3-chloro-2-fluorobenzyl group (CH2 at C1, F at C2, Cl at C3) is bonded through NH-C(=O)-CH2- to an N(iPr)-C(=O)-CH2- unit whose CH2 is on the N1 of an indole. The indole has Ac at C3 and, at C5, a CH2-C(=O) group acylating the N of a piperidine that carries two F on C3 (the second ring atom away from N, via the CH2 next to N).
58738dee0a.notes: Typeset reference-style drawing. Double bonds: 3 in the benzene ring, 4 in the indole (C2=C3 plus three in the benzo ring), 3 C=O.
